title: How Marcus Fenix became a Gears of War legend
subject: marcus
description:
Would you have followed Marcus into the Hollow? 👇

The story of Marcus Fenix before the Locust war, as Gears of War: E-Day launches. Light spoilers for the Gears of War series.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by The Coalition or Xbox Game Studios. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Marcus Fenix was already a war hero before the Locust surfaced.
He was the son of Adam Fenix, a brilliant scientist. His mother, Elain, went missing when he was a boy.
He grew up beside his best friend, Dom Santiago, and they fought side by side in the Pendulum Wars.
There, Marcus earned the Embry Star, the COG's highest medal for valor. But the real war hadn't started yet.
On Emergence Day, monsters burst from underground and attacked cities across the planet at once.
